children: France video game publisher's H1 sales beat analyst expectations, but adjusted EPS missed
Adjusted operating income for H1 missed consensus
H1 net bookings fell 17% yr/yr, with Q2 net bookings above company guidance
Ubisoft expects Q3 2026-27 net bookings of around €250 mln
Company confirms FY2026-27 guidance: net bookings down by high single-digit percentage
Ubisoft expects to return to positive free cash flow and EBIT in FY2027-28

ASSASSIN'S CREED BLACK FLAG RESYNCED - Q2 outperformance mainly driven by strong commercial performance of Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced, supported by in-game spending and higher premium edition sales
NEW OPERATING MODEL - Co said new operating model, with empowered creative teams and closer player engagement, delivered first tangible benefits, including improved performance for key titles
COST REDUCTION - Fixed cost base down 6% yr/yr and headcount reduced by about 1,100 as part of ongoing cost reduction program
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ubisoft Entertainment SA is €5.00, about 17.5% above its November 18 closing price of €4.26
Nov 19 - Ubisoft to cut 166 jobs in Montréal and Québec City
Nov 17 - Grand Theft Auto VI heads to launch amid feverish anticipation
